dessin: A small entity card: one landscape flat pale card #FBFCF8, proportions 3 by 2, with a 2 px ink outline and sharp corners. One thin horizontal ink line crosses the card at 72% of its height, dividing it in two parts. Upper part: filled edge to edge with thin evenly spaced horizontal grey #7D8576 lines, about ten of them, like a ruled sheet. In the middle of the upper part, one land parcel outline seen from above: an irregular five-sided polygon, no right angle, wider than tall, with its vertices at about (30%, 12%), (66%, 9%), (75%, 38%), (60%, 60%) and (27%, 54%) of the card width and height; crisp 3 px ink #23281F outline, interior flat pale #FBFCF8 covering the grey lines. Lower part: plain pale, with one single short horizontal grey #545B4C bar, 3 px thick, starting at 12% of the card width and ending at 66%, vertically centered in the lower part, like a line of text without letters. Not a building: no windows, no roof, no hatching. No letters, nothing else.
